label: late input position ramp (t >= 6) through the <DEL> step
explanation: Fires late in the input phase and peaks on the <DEL> step: it is silent at t 0-2, rare at t 3-5, and turns on at absolute step t >= 6 (rate about 25% at t=6, 37% at t=7-8, 88% at original position 8). It almost never fires in the copy phase (6 activations). Strength builds step by step over the last few original tokens and is highest on <DEL> (58% of activation mass, 57% of <DEL> steps active), so it is strongest for long sequences (L=9 holds 48% of mass). The top examples are L=9 sequences that start with z. It responds mainly to position, not token identity (lifts by token are flat), though repeated tokens (in_first=0) fire less. Precision is limited: many t>=6 / <DEL> steps stay off with no clear token-level reason, and some <DEL> steps at t=5 fire weakly. Dev: P 0.64, R 0.91, mass recall 0.96.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the input two steps back (most: y, d, a, v, r, t; least: w, l, z, -) and the current input token (most: <DEL>, y, d, r, x, v; least: w, l, b, z); timing cues that raise it most: t=7, L=9 & t=8, t=8.
